args: const fs=require('node:fs');const p='/state/journal';const files=fs.readdirSync(p).filter(n=>n.endsWith('.pending.json'));if(files.length!==1)throw new Error('expected one operator-reviewed pending record');const file=p+'/'+files[0];const r=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file,'utf8'));fs.renameSync(file,p+'/'+r.request.requestId+'.operator-reconciled.json');console.log(JSON.stringify({action:'operator-archived-observed-denial',requestId:r.request.requestId}));
